description: This line plot illustrates the performance of two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, on a metric labeled “Missing Step,” plotted against an integer x-axis ranging from 0 to 4. The y-axis, labeled “Missing Step,” spans from approximately 0.845 to 0.860, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.005. The blue dashed line with circular markers, labeled “0-CoT,” starts at approximately 0.8595 when x=0, decreases steadily to about 0.850 at x=2, continues declining to roughly 0.8475 at x=3, and ends at approximately 0.844 at x=4. The orange solid line with triangular markers, labeled “CoRe,” begins at approximately 0.8595 at x=0, decreases to about 0.854 at x=1, reaches 0.850 at x=2, then flattens slightly to around 0.848 at x=3 and remains nearly constant at 0.848 at x=4. Both lines show a general downward trend, with 0-CoT declining more consistently and ending at a lower value than CoRe.
